lines.text: Meetings drift. Decisions get lost. Your transcript? In someone else's cloud.
Sivlo records and transcribes in real time — on your Mac, fully on device.
Afterwards, Sivlo distills the meeting — summary, actions, decisions you can keep.
Every word stays on your device. Privacy is the product.
Sivlo — working memory for your next meeting. Download the beta.
